mapper.select: SELECT code, name FROM ( SELECT sys09_code AS code , sys09_name AS name , sys09_seq AS seq FROM sys09_code INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'ItemLClassCode' AND sys09_code LIKE '5%' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn, 'false') = 'false' UNION ALL SELECT '95' AS code , '소모품_비품' AS name , '95' AS seq ) t ORDER BY seq

SELECT row_number() over(order by ast01_item_s_class_cd) AS book_depn_id , ast13_item_type AS item_type , sum(ast13_pur_amt) AS pur_amt FROM ( SELECT ast13_pur_amt , ast01_item_s_class_cd , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ast01_item_s_class_cd,5,2) = '99' THEN f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) WHEN SUBSTR(ast01_item_s_class_cd,1,2) = '95' THEN '소모품(비품)' ELSE f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) END ast13_item_type FROM ast13_book_depn a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast13_ast_class_tree_id WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast13_depn_date = ( SELECT MAX(ast13_depn_date) FROM ast13_book_depn b WHERE b.ast13_company_id = a.ast13_company_id AND b.ast13_pur_tr_id = a.ast13_pur_tr_id AND b.ast13_depn_date <= #{depnDate} ) AND COALESCE(ast13_retire_date,'9999-12-31') > #{depnDate} ) t GROUP BY ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_item_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_date01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_long01 , sys99_string04, sys99_string05, sys99_date02 ) VALUES ( #{printId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , #{b.itemType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.purDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{b.itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.note,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.purAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{b.corpName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.corpTel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.retireDate,jdbcType=DATE} )

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS book_depn_id , ast13_item_type AS item_type , SUM(t.ast13_pur_amt + t.ast13_non_deduct_tax) AS pur_amt , SUM(t.ast13_depn_cost) AS depn_cost , SUM(t.ast13_acm_depn_cost) AS acm_depn_cost , SUM(t.ast13_rem_depn_cost + t.ast13_non_deduct_tax) AS rem_depn_cost FROM ( SELECT ast13_book_depn_id , ast13_pur_amt , ast13_acm_depn_cost , CASE WHEN to_char(ast13_depn_date,'YYYY') = to_char(CAST(#{depnDate} AS date),'YYYY') THEN ast13_depn_cost ELSE 0 END AS ast13_depn_cost , ast13_pur_amt - COALESCE(ast13_acm_depn_cost,0) AS ast13_rem_depn_cost , f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) AS ast13_item_type , COALESCE(( SELECT ast16_apply_non_deduct_tax FROM ast16_non_deduct_tax WHERE ast16_pur_tr_id = ast13_pur_tr_id AND ast16_apply_date <= #{depnDate} ORDER BY ast16_apply_date DESC LIMIT 1 ),0) AS ast13_non_deduct_tax FROM ast13_book_depn INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ( ast01_class_tree_id = ast13_ast_class_tree_id AND ast01_depn_type IS NOT NULL ) WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND (ast13_pur_tr_id, ast13_depn_date) IN ( SELECT ast13_pur_tr_id, MAX(ast13_depn_date) FROM ast13_book_depn WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast13_depn_date <= #{depnDate} GROUP BY ast13_pur_tr_id ) AND COALESCE(ast13_retire_date,'9999-12-31') > #{depnDate} ) t GROUP BY ast13_item_type ORDER BY ast13_item_type DESC
